question: Who became the Chief Minister of Delhi after the February 2025 Legislative Assembly elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rekha Gupta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rekha Gupta** became the Chief Minister of Delhi following the results of the February 2025 Legislative Assembly elections.
 
• She is associated with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, which emerged victorious in the elections, securing a majority in the Delhi Assembly.
 
• Rekha Gupta is known for her leadership skills and active engagement in policymaking and grassroots-level governance.
 
• The February 2025 elections were marked by significant political shifts, with BJP capitalizing on issues of development, governance, and local concerns to win over the electorate.
 
• Her tenure is expected to focus on improving civic amenities, infrastructure, and addressing environmental concerns in Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arvind Kejriwal**

 
 
• Arvind Kejriwal served as the Chief Minister of Delhi before the February 2025 elections.
 
• He is the national convenor of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), which focused on delivering public services like education, healthcare, and water supply during its governance.
 
• Under his leadership, AAP introduced initiatives such as the Mohalla Clinics and reforms in government schools.
 
• Despite his popularity, AAP faced challenges in the 2025 elections, losing its majority to the BJP.
 
 
 
• **Parvesh Verma**
 
 
• Parvesh Verma is a Member of Parliament from the BJP and known for his contributions to public welfare and development projects.
 
• He has represented the West Delhi constituency and is recognized for his active participation in parliamentary debates.
 
• Although a prominent BJP leader, he did not contest for the Chief Minister’s position in the 2025 elections.
 
 
 
• **Atishi Marlena**
 
 
• Atishi Marlena is an influential leader of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and has been instrumental in shaping education policies in Delhi.
 
• She played a key role in introducing reforms in government schools and improving educational infrastructure.
 
• Despite her achievements, AAP faced setbacks in the 2025 elections, and she did not secure the Chief Minister’s position.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme**
 
 
• The Delhi Legislative Assembly elections are held every five years to elect the Chief Minister and the ruling party in the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
 
• These elections are crucial as they determine the governance and policy direction for Delhi, one of India’s most significant metropolitan cities.
 
• Political parties focus on local issues such as infrastructure development, pollution control, and public services to appeal to the voters.
